snippet.title: There's a Funny Feeling in my Tummy (FNaF Fangame Trailer)
snippet.description:
FOLLOW THE GAME HERE: https://gamejolt.com/games/TaFFimT/1062824

Freddy's Pizza is set to close permanently after years of poor management and scandals, with the disappearance of a child during a birthday party being the final straw.

Albert, a washed up high school dropout, picks up the pizzeria's final overnight shift for some extra cash before everything is packed up and sold off. His job is to keep the building up and running until the movers arrive, all while keeping an eye on the animatronics, which have begun turning up in different parts of the pizzeria where they aren't supposed to be in the days following the disappearance.

Albert will have to hold down the fort and keep the animatronics in check until 6:00 AM.
